pages.text: $(l)Alcohol$() intoxicates: a lot — nausea, too much — you pass out. $(l)Tobacco$() slightly numbs pain, smokers' lungs suffer. $(l)Caffeine$() speeds up the pulse. $(l)Opioids$() numb pain and depress breathing.
Frequent use builds $(l)tolerance$() and $(l)dependence$(): without the substance comes withdrawal — pain, everything slower.
